summary_en: Starknet launched Shadow Accounts, which let apps give users a public-to-private switch. StarkWare assessed Ethereum's crypto agility against 8 criteria and says it passes only 3. The ERC-7562 PR banning SETCODEFROM was merged, and EIP-8141 clarified transient storage and deploy targets in its trace rules. Justin Drake, the EF, LambdaClass and others met with more than a hundred cryptographers in Cambridge.
